proceedings.deciding_body: the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board
proceedings.outcome: resolved to transfer the management and control of İktisat Bankası T.A.Ş. to the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund
proceedings.supporting_quote: By a decision dated 15 March 2001, the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board ( Bankalar Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurulu , hereinafter “the Board”) resolved to transfer the management and control of İktisat Bankası T.A.Ş. (hereinafter “İktisat Bank” or “the Bank”) to the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund ( Tasarruf Mevduat Sigorta Fonu , hereinafter “the Fund”)

proceedings.outcome: resolved to recover 726,122,000 Turkish liras from the former shareholders
proceedings.supporting_quote: on 14 September 2001, the Fund resolved to recover 726,122,000 Turkish liras from the former shareholders by taking all necessary measures

proceedings.outcome: decided to rely on provisions concerning default and initiate legal proceedings and sale of assets
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 3 April 2008, the Fund concluded that the Erol Aksoy Group had failed to fulfil several commitments and obligations set out in the Liquidation Protocol... Consequently, the Fund decided to rely on its provisions concerning default.

proceedings.outcome: resolved to transfer the management and control of all companies within the Erol Aksoy Group to itself
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 18 September 2008, the Fund further resolved to transfer the management and control of all companies within the Erol Aksoy Group to itself

proceedings.outcome: decided to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale and set the estimated value at USD 6,000,000
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 13 January 2011, the Fund decided to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale again, setting the reserve price at USD 6,000,000.

proceedings.outcome: proceedings initiated to annul the Fund's decision of 13 January 2011
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, contesting the actions of the Fund concerning the tendering of Viva TV-Radio Viva... The applicant sought the annulment of all measures related to the sale, including the Fund’s decision of 13 January 2011

proceedings.outcome: proceedings initiated seeking the annulment of the sale of Viva TV-Radio Viva
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 24 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, seeking the annulment of the sale of Viva TV-Radio Viva.

proceedings.deciding_body: the 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 19 March 2014, the 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court dismissed the applicant’s claim, concluding that no legal irregularities had occurred in the tendering and sale procedures.

proceedings.deciding_body: the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.outcome: dismissed the applicant's case (regarding the decision of 13 January 2011) and upheld the dismissal of the sale annulment claim
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 9 December 2014, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court dismissed the applicant’s case... On an appeal by the applicant, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court upheld that decision [of 19 March 2014] on 9 December 2014.

proceedings.deciding_body: the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 July 2015, following an appeal by the applicant, the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court... annulled the Fund’s decision.

proceedings.outcome: rejected the Fund’s request for rectification
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 25 January 2016, the Supreme Administrative Court rejected the Fund’s request for rectification

proceedings.outcome: determined that the annulment decision could not be enforced
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 18 April 2016, the Fund notified the applicant of a decision taken on 27 October 2015 regarding the impossibility of enforcing the judgment... the Fund determined that the annulment decision could not be enforced

proceedings.deciding_body: the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.outcome: granted the request for rectification, overturned the judgment of the 6th Chamber of the Istanbul Administrative Court and annulled the sale
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 30 June 2017, the 13 th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court granted the request... the court overturned the judgment of the 6th Chamber of the Istanbul Administrative Court dated 19 March 2014 and annulled the sale in question.

proceedings.outcome: refused to enforce the annulment judgment
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 September 2017, the Fund responded, stating that a decision had already been made on 11 August 2017 regarding the enforcement of the relevant judgment... the Fund reiterated the same reasons... for not enforcing the court’s decision
In a decision of 23 May 2018, the Constitutional Court... declared the application inadmissible.
